name: 60502 · Aurora, IL
findings: ZIP 60502 (Aurora) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60502 (Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60502 (Aurora) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
